question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

 Preserve
solution:
The correct answer is: **Maintain**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Preserve"** means to keep something in its original state or protect it from damage or decay. (संरक्षित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The organization works to preserve endangered species from extinction.
 
 
 
• **"Maintain"** refers to keeping something in good condition or retaining its original state over time. (बरकरार रखना)
 
 
• **Example:** He made sure to maintain the cleanliness of his office every day.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **'Preserve'** is **'Maintain'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Maintain**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Consume** (खपत करना): To use up or eat something.

 
 
• **Example:** He consumed the entire bottle of water after the long run.
 
 
 
• **Complain** (शिकायत करना): To express dissatisfaction or annoyance about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She complained about the slow service at the restaurant.
 
 
 
• **Ignore** (नज़रअंदाज़ करना): To deliberately pay no attention to something.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to ignore the negative comments on his work..
